name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Israeli ground raid in central Gaza 18 Nov
summary: Israeli tanks crossed the Yellow Line into central Gaza on 18 Nov, the first such advance since the Oct 2025 ceasefire
state: On 18 Nov Israeli tanks advanced along Salahudeen road near Nuseirat and Bureij camps, which residents called the first advance across the Yellow Line since the October 2025 ceasefire; the military said it was targeting Hamas infrastructure and Hamas called it a ceasefire violation (Reuters via CP24). Hospital officials said three Palestinians were killed in the operation (Al Jazeera). Alongside Iran's strikes on Gulf states, this keeps the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Occupied Palestinian Territories, Lebanon and the Gulf, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation: Gaza ground raid (18 Nov) plus Iran–Gulf strikes = Alert
